journey.name: receive invoice refresh
journey.description: Verifies that reopening Receive and editing its amount leaves Auto with a ready unified invoice. Requires a running Lightning node and a ready channel with sufficient inbound capacity for the entered amount. Record the QR changes and inspect or decode their contents; a screenshot of a loading placeholder alone does not establish a failure. This journey is pending device validation.

actions.action: Launch Bitkit and open Receive from the wallet home screen
Select Auto and wait for its QR code to finish loading
Verify the Auto QR URI contains both the Bitcoin address and a nonempty lightning parameter
Close and reopen Receive three times in quick succession, then select Auto
If Auto shows loading, verify Copy and Share are disabled while Edit remains available
Wait for the QR code to finish loading and verify its URI still contains a nonempty lightning parameter
Open Edit, enter a small amount within the channel's inbound capacity, and return to the QR code
Immediately reopen Edit, change the amount to a different small amount, type a new note, and return to Auto
Wait for the QR code to finish loading and verify its URI contains the latest amount and a nonempty lightning parameter
Decode the Lightning invoice and verify its amount and description match the latest amount and note entered
Reopen Edit and verify the latest note remains present
